_info: ClimaCredit Q – all assumptions in one place. Change a value here and the notebook, the quantum model and the server all use it. Each entry has a value and a source.

bank_size_meur.source: Assumption: corporate loan book of a typical local OP cooperative bank (a few hundred MEUR).

lgd.source: Basel foundation IRB LGD for senior unsecured corporate exposures.

rho_climate.source: Assumption: agriculture and construction are the most climate-sensitive sectors (ECB 2022 climate stress test).

flood_rho_add.source: Assumption: extra climate sensitivity for regions with a designated significant flood risk area.

flood_regions.source: Regions with confirmed significant flood risk areas 2025-2030 (Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry, Dec 2024): Kyronjoki, Laihianjoki, Lapvaartinjoki (Ostrobothnia regions), Pori (Satakunta), Alavieska-Ylivieska (North Ostrobothnia), Rovaniemi (Lapland). Finland has 18 in total - add the rest when known.

pd_agriculture_national.source: Starting PD of EU banks' agricultural loans, ECB/ESAs Fit-for-55 climate scenario analysis (Nov 2024).

regional_weight.source: Assumption: how much we trust regional differences in agricultural bankruptcy rates (0 = same PD everywhere, 1 = full regional difference). Regional counts are small (about 5-15 per year), so we use half.

pd_scale_construction_trade.source: Multiplier on Statistics Finland bankruptcy rates for construction and trade (1.0 = use bankruptcy rates as PD).

scenarios.source: Average corporate PD rises from 2.4% by +0.6 / +1.3 / +2.3 p.p. to 2030, ECB/ESAs Fit-for-55 climate scenario analysis (Nov 2024).

main_scenario.source: Choice: the disorderly transition scenario of Fit-for-55.

bank_margin.source: Simplification: the bank's existing margin, which already covers today's credit risk and costs.

euribor_fallback.source: Fallback 12-month Euribor if the live ECB feed is unavailable. Update before the demo.

cost_of_capital.source: Assumption: required return on the bank's equity used to price the extra capital a loan needs.

firm_adjustment.source: Assumption: PD multiplier from the firm's key ratios relative to the sector average.

equity_ratio_limits.source: Finnish Yritystutkimus standard: equity ratio >40% strong, 20-40% satisfactory, <20% weak.

net_debt_ebitda_limits.source: Bank rule of thumb: net debt/EBITDA <3 strong, 3-5 satisfactory, >5 weak.
